_about: One question per group, written from eval/topic_briefs.json as a product researcher would ask it. Every pair in a group reuses the same wording, so the as_of date is the only thing that changes between pairs. Rules (eval/prompts/02_questions.md): no complaint wording, no fixes, features, or release names, and no words that hint at the answer (still, anymore, now that, recently, after the update).

questions.sidebar: What do we know about how people get around their pages using the sidebar?
questions.code blocks and pages: What problems do people run into when writing and reusing pages?
questions.relations: What do we know about how people connect databases to each other?
questions.large databases: What is it like for people to work with databases that hold many rows?
questions.mobile: What problems do people have using Tessera on phones and tablets?
questions.calendar: What do we know about how people schedule their time with Tessera Calendar?
questions.mail: What problems do people have keeping up with email in Tessera Mail?
questions.ai trust: How much do people trust the answers Tessera AI gives them?
questions.ai usage and languages: What do we know about how workspaces adopt and oversee Tessera AI?
questions.guests and permissions: What do we know about sharing pages and keeping track of who can see them?
questions.recurring templates: How do teams handle documents they produce on a regular schedule?
questions.search: What problems do people have finding information with search?
questions.slack: What do people think about how Tessera activity reaches them in Slack?
questions.checkout and billing: What do we know about paying for Tessera and managing plans?
questions.slash menu: What do we know about how people add new blocks to a page?
questions.github: How do engineering teams use Tessera alongside GitHub?
questions.accessibility: What problems do people have using Tessera with assistive technology or without a mouse?
questions.api v1: What do we know about developers building on the Tessera API for pages?
questions.webhooks: How do developers keep external systems in sync with Tessera databases?
questions.ai autofill: What do we know about keeping database properties filled in as rows pile up?
questions.desktop apps: How reliable are the Tessera desktop apps over a workday?
questions.security and sign-in: How do organizations control sign-in to Tessera?
questions.microsoft teams: How does Tessera fit companies whose daily communication runs outside Slack?
